runtime_encoding.global_branch: lossless uint64 PC plus lossless 58-bit cache-line number
runtime_encoding.pc_local_branch: current line58 plus causal same-PC signed-delta58, reuse-age64, and previous-observation-valid bit

architecture.global_state: single-layer chronological LSTM carried across every callback
architecture.pc_local_state: single-layer LSTM dynamically routed by exact observed PC with no copied Stride tracker capacity
architecture.local_validity: learned sigmoid fusion gate over global and PC-local contexts
architecture.fusion: global context concatenated with softly gated PC-local context
architecture.stateful_training: chronological TBPTT; global and exact-PC local states cross chunks and detach at chunk boundaries
architecture.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology; only evaluation callbacks are decoded

action_grammar.request_count: rank-wise learned categorical STOP/EMIT; sampled STOP is absorbing and still-active ranks at or beyond teacher K retain STOP as the label
action_grammar.decoding: stateless event/rank/field-keyed inverse-CDF sampling until learned STOP

target_codec.coordinate: first target relative to demand line; each later target relative to the previous target
target_codec.small_stride_behavior: small signed increments normally use one byte
target_codec.training_objective: full canonical autoregressive teacher-prefix NLL in an isolated loss-only branch at each sampled-EMIT rank that has a teacher target
target_codec.decoding: stateless keyed inverse-CDF over seven shared payload bits and continuation; canonical terminal-zero masks; ninth-byte payload restricted to 1..3 and forced END
target_codec.feedback: only actual hard sampled STOP/EMIT, payload-bit, and continuation tokens mutate the main rollout state in training and inference
target_codec.teacher_prefix_branch: teacher tokens condition logits and recurrently advance an isolated loss-only likelihood state; they cannot mutate the main rollout state or origin
target_codec.supervision_origin: teacher absolute target is re-encoded relative to the model's actual previous sampled target (or current demand for rank 0)

sampler.stop_support_check: fail closed when learned STOP mass has no representable inverse-CDF interval
sampler.nontermination_watchdog: rank limit equals sampler grid precision; reaching it raises and produces no replay, never truncates or forces STOP

captured_stride_actions_role: normal replay and supervised sequence labels only
gradient_accumulation: weighted by exact categorical atom count to preserve the global natural sequence NLL
parameter_formula_source: python/model_contract.py; measured against the instantiated module and asserted exactly
persistent_state_accounting: 2H float32 global values plus 2H float32 values per observed PC; reported separately from weights
